A '''command relay''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] component that was used to control a [[drone freighter]].

==History==
{{Quote|Chewbacca, I need ''manual flight'' control, ''now''!|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="Drone Alone" />}}
[[File:Command_relay_override.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] manually overrides the command relay of [[drone vessel 171]]]]

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of [[drone freighter]]s was en route to the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] with a cargo of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] components. When [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] learned of this convoy, the Alliance mounted a daring [[Mission to steal hyperdrive components|mission]] to intercept one of those [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]].<ref name="Drone Alone" />

Infiltrating [[drone vessel 171]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] had to bypass the [[Drone barge/Legends|drone]] freighter's command relay to allow [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to take control of the helm and weapons system. However, the access tube leading to the junction terminal being too narrow, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] had to brutally remove the panel covering it. Running out of time to properly reprogram the command relay, Chewbacca manually overrode it by rewiring two cables of the junction terminal. Gaining full control of the freighter, the Rebels captured drone vessel 171 and made their jump to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]].<ref name="Drone Alone" />
